title: Pulmonary fibrosis, scleroderma lung, tracheostomy and ventilator
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's lung fibrosis or airway status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for pulmonary fibrosis.

HPI
Pt is a 75 y.o. female presenting for routine follow-up of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis. She reports she has been feeling stable since the last visit. Denies increased dyspnea on exertion or new cough. Compliant with current antifibrotic medication. Reports good activity level at home.

Medication List
Nintedanib 150 mg BID.

Exam
Gen: Well-appearing, in no acute distress.
Resp: CTAB, RRR. Breath sounds diminished at bases, no wheezing/crackles.
CV: RRR, no murmurs.
Ext: No cyanosis, good capillary refill.

Assessment
1. Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis. Stable. Pulmonary function tests (PFTs) remain stable since last evaluation. Patient tolerating current antifibrotic therapy well.

Plan
1. Continue current antifibrotic dosing.
2. F/u in 6 months for repeat PFTs and clinical assessment.
3. Encouraged continued activity as tolerated.

Electronically signed, E. Castillo, DO, 05/14/2026
refs: ICD-10-CM Tabular: J84, M34, Z93, Z99
